reviewItem.question: Does "Line removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: return errors.New(\"Crossplane no longer supports loading and patching EnvironmentConfigs natively. Please use…" mean a change to cli-flag:crossplane|name=--enable-environment-configs (removed)?

proposed.statement: In v2.0.0, cmd/crossplane/core/core.go removed the error-return naming --enable-environment-configs ("Crossplane no longer supports loading and patching EnvironmentConfigs natively. Please use function-environment-configs instead. The --enable-environment-configs flag will be removed in a future release."), deleting the v1.20.1 handling of that flag.
